title: Tech Note: Data Cleaning and Deduplication
author: David Adams

historical_commentary.text: This note is a well-written, largely platform-agnostic overview of data cleaning and record-deduplication methodology (standardization, blocking/reducing comparison sets, fuzzy matching, human-reviewed merging, and probabilistic weighting) that remains conceptually sound today, even though it is tied to the long-superseded, third-party FuzzyTools component and 4D 2004-era commands like APPLY XSLT TRANSFORMATION. The specific commercial address-cleaning vendors mentioned (PostCode Anywhere, AddressDoctor, DesertSoft) and the free USPS/UPS web tools referenced are almost certainly changed, rebranded, or defunct two decades later. As a methodology primer the note holds up well; as a concrete how-to tied to specific 4D commands and vendors it is dated.
related_updates: The FuzzyTools component described here is a third-party/community add-on from this era, not a built-in 4D feature, and is not maintained as part of modern 4D

The specific commercial address-verification vendors and free postal web services named (PostCode Anywhere, AddressDoctor, DesertSoft, USPS/UPS web tools) should be independently re-verified as current offerings have likely changed substantially
